name: Rurik
occupation: gate guard at the border post
background: Rurik has stood the night watch at the toll gate for eleven years. He knows every carter by name and most smugglers by their boots.
temperament: Slow to anger and steady as a wall; he likes order and long, unhurried evenings, and would rather watch the room than join it. Drink turns him mean late at night, and he carries a short cudgel.
speech: Few words, low voice, dry jokes delivered without a smile; says 'aye' instead of yes.
quirks: Always sits facing the door; polishes his belt buckle with his thumb; falls asleep sitting upright.
secret: He takes a coin now and then to look the other way, and the captain is starting to suspect.
goal: Drink in peace after a double watch, mostly alone with his back to the wall, and keep an eye on any stranger who asks about the gate.
